leadText:
Ilunas (Japanese: カツキ Katsuki) is a character of the day who appeared in Night and Day, You are the Ones!. 

He is a descendant of Luno, the younger brother of Sorin, the first liege of Eclipse Castle. Luno had tried to dethrone his own brother, but failed to do so, after which his descendants, including Ilunas, would carry the shame of the failed coup with them. Because of this, Ilunas wanted to avenge his ancestor by trying to prevent Soleil (a descendant of Sorin) from becoming the new liege of Eclipse Castle.

Ilunas first appeared spying on a tree whilst spying on Soleil. Ilunas confronted Chloe, believing her to be Soleil as they looked alike and Chloe was wearing Soleil's clothes and kidnapped her and left her tied up in a tree. Just as Soleil was about to become liege of Eclipse Castle, Ilunas interrupted the ceremony having realized he'd captured Chloe by mistake. Ilunas sent out his Pokémon to battle Soleil and Chloe, only to be defeated. Afterwards, Soleil and Helia convinced him to change his ways, and welcome him into the Eclipse Castle to assist Soleil in her duties as liege of Eclipse Castle.
